title: The fixed rule on neto1 v2 and on net1 v8 (27 LCFs), validation links: the u grid over three campaign seeds
description: neto1 v2 (release exp-neto1-v2-239, the run in chosen.txt) and net1 v8 (release exp-net1v8-238, chosen.txt) are the two architectures trained with the 27-LCF set: one value per LCF, and a distribution per LCF (64 bins, 3 members). The fixed rule reads only the believed bandwidth-delay product, so this run asks whether adding 20 heads moved the rule on either net1. Its u is chosen on each as in rule-net1point-val.json, which chose 0.125 on neto1 v1 and 0.25 on net1 v7 (release exp-rule-net1point-val-234): u in -0.25, 0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.375, 0.5 (arms v2-u* on neto1 v2, v8-u* on net1 v8), with BBRv3 beside them, on the 21 validation links and five families, for campaign seeds 11, 21 and 31; the winner per net1 is the u with the highest mean over the five families on every seed, or, where seeds disagree or the gap is inside the noise, the one ahead on the mean over seeds. Validation links only.
prepare: U="-0.25 0 0.125 0.25 0.375 0.5"; P=(); for a in v2:n v8:m; do k=${a%:*} i=${a#*:}; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/$k" "$IN/$i/$(cat "$IN/$i/chosen.txt")/net1.pt" --u $U; for u in $U; do P+=(--policy "$k-u$u=$OUT/$k/rule-u$u.onnx"); done; done; for s in 11 21 31; do mkdir -p "$OUT/s$s"; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT/s$s" val $s $s bbr3 "${P[@]}"; done
run: for c in "$OUT"/s*/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done
collect: for s in 11 21 31; do uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT/s$s" --select v2 v8; done; { for s in 11 21 31; do echo "# Campaign seed $s"; cat "$OUT/s$s/summary.md"; echo; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
